note: C5R is a retrofit checkpoint. It does NOT advance any productionCapability beyond C5; enabledCapabilitiesBefore === enabledCapabilitiesAfter. The retrofit modifies one already-authorised production file (renderer/js/r3-0c-corner-segmentation.js — bounded O(n^2) overlap-scan extension, no algorithm replacement) and four contracts; declares three new governance-capabilities (phase_boundary_contract / viewmodel_state_transition_contract / framing_source_structured_contract — all DISABLED) that gate the deferred C7_UI surface; persists Codex C-A evidence in tiered form under governance/r3.0c/codex-ca-gate-evidence/; and explicitly separates reviewedCandidateSha / manifestCommitSha / integrationSha so future audits cannot conflate them. The trusted-verification artifact bound to the eventual Train integrationSha is the PASS authority for THAT integration; reviewedCandidateSha is the PASS authority only for the pre-merge retrofit candidate. headSha / workflowRunId / artifactId / artifactBoundSha / createdAt are intentionally null in-commit, mirroring the existing C0-C5 manifest convention. status='pending' per the same convention; PASS lives in the trusted-verification artifact, not in this file.
